method: two single-side eval.py processes (no in-process pairing); per-case delta = candidate.gain - baseline.gain keyed by case_id
timing_note: api_total_seconds includes hif4_calibration_and_quantize_weight (about 128 s on a cache miss, 0.0 s on a hit) and is therefore not comparable across runs; the delta above uses hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation only, 56 calls per shard on both sides with no calibration.  This is still a cross-process, cross-time comparison and is a local proxy number, not an official second.
